subject: Tiếng Anh
title: Đề ôn giữa học kì 1 – Tiếng Anh 11 (đề số 1)
scope: Unit 1: A long and healthy life; Unit 2: The generation gap; Unit 3: Cities of the future (Global Success)

questions.q: Choose the word whose underlined part is pronounced differently from that of the others.
questions.e: “meat” có “ea” đọc /iː/; “healthy”, “breath”, “head” có “ea” đọc /e/.

questions.q: Choose the word whose underlined part is pronounced differently from that of the others.
questions.e: Động từ tận cùng /t/, /d/ thì “-ed” đọc /ɪd/: “attended”. Các từ còn lại tận cùng /k/, /s/, /tʃ/ nên “-ed” đọc /t/.

questions.q: Choose the word that differs from the other three in the position of primary stress.
questions.e: “existence” /ɪɡˈzɪstəns/ nhấn âm 2; “exercise”, “attitude”, “nutrient” nhấn âm 1.

questions.q: Choose the word that differs from the other three in the position of primary stress.
questions.e: “urban” /ˈɜːbən/ nhấn âm 1; “respect”, “control”, “believe” nhấn âm 2.

questions.t: Unit 1: A long and healthy life – Vocabulary
questions.q:
Choose the best answer to complete the sentence.

People in Japan have a high life ______; many of them live to over 80.
questions.e: Cụm danh từ cố định “life expectancy” = tuổi thọ trung bình.

questions.t: Unit 1: A long and healthy life – Vocabulary
questions.q:
Choose the best answer to complete the sentence.

You should ______ down on sugary drinks if you want to stay healthy.
questions.e: “cut down on sth” = cắt giảm (lượng tiêu thụ) cái gì.

questions.t: Unit 1: A long and healthy life – Vocabulary
questions.q:
Choose the best answer to complete the sentence.

Regular exercise helps to boost your ______ system, so you are less likely to catch colds and flu.
questions.e: “immune system” = hệ miễn dịch, giúp cơ thể chống lại cảm cúm.

questions.q:
Choose the best answer to complete the sentence.

In a(n) ______ family, grandparents, parents and children all live together under one roof.
questions.e: “extended family” = gia đình nhiều thế hệ; “nuclear family” chỉ gồm bố mẹ và con.

questions.q:
Choose the best answer to complete the sentence.

My grandparents are rather ______. They don't like it when I dye my hair or wear ripped jeans.
questions.e: “conservative” = bảo thủ, phù hợp với việc không thích kiểu tóc, quần áo mới lạ.

questions.q:
Choose the best answer to complete the sentence.

The ______ gap often causes conflicts between parents and teenagers over values and lifestyles.
questions.e: “generation gap” = khoảng cách thế hệ.

questions.t: Unit 3: Cities of the future – Vocabulary
questions.q:
Choose the best answer to complete the sentence.

A ______ city uses technology to manage traffic, energy and public services efficiently.
questions.e: “smart city” = thành phố thông minh (ứng dụng công nghệ để quản lí).

questions.t: Unit 3: Cities of the future – Vocabulary
questions.q:
Choose the best answer to complete the sentence.

Good ______ such as roads, bridges and public transport systems is essential for a sustainable city.
questions.e: “infrastructure” = cơ sở hạ tầng (đường sá, cầu cống, giao thông công cộng).

questions.t: Unit 1 – Grammar: Past simple vs present perfect
questions.q:
Choose the best answer to complete the sentence.

My grandfather ______ jogging every morning since he retired.
questions.e: Có “since + mốc thời gian” → thì hiện tại hoàn thành: has gone.

questions.t: Unit 1 – Grammar: Past simple vs present perfect
questions.q:
Choose the best answer to complete the sentence.

I ______ a health check-up last month, and the doctor said I was fine.
questions.e: “last month” là thời điểm xác định trong quá khứ → quá khứ đơn: had.

questions.t: Unit 1 – Grammar: Past simple vs present perfect
questions.q:
Choose the best answer to complete the sentence.

This is the first time I ______ yoga. It's really relaxing!
questions.e: Cấu trúc “This is the first time + S + have/has + V3” → have tried.

questions.t: Unit 2 – Grammar: Modal verbs (must, have to, should)
questions.q:
Choose the best answer to complete the sentence.

In Viet Nam, you ______ wear a helmet when you ride a motorbike. It's the law.
questions.e: Bắt buộc do luật quy định → “have to”.

questions.t: Unit 2 – Grammar: Modal verbs (must, have to, should)
questions.q:
Choose the best answer to complete the sentence.

If you have problems at school, you ______ talk to your parents. They may be able to help.
questions.e: Lời khuyên → “should”.

questions.t: Unit 2 – Grammar: Modal verbs (must, have to, should)
questions.q:
Choose the best answer to complete the sentence.

Students ______ use mobile phones during the exam. It's strictly forbidden.
questions.e: “strictly forbidden” = bị cấm → “mustn't”. “don't have to/needn't” chỉ là không cần thiết.

questions.q:
Choose the best answer to complete the sentence.

This soup ______ delicious. Can I have some more?
questions.e: “taste” (có vị) là động từ trạng thái, không dùng tiếp diễn; chủ ngữ số ít → tastes.

questions.q:
Choose the best answer to complete the sentence.

We ______ about moving to a smart city, but we haven't made a final decision yet.
questions.e: “think about” mang nghĩa đang cân nhắc (hành động) nên dùng được thì tiếp diễn; chủ ngữ “we” → are thinking.

questions.q:
Choose the most suitable response to complete the exchange.

Mai: “You look really fit. How do you keep in shape?”
Nam: “______”
o: I work out at the gym three times a week.
questions.e: Câu hỏi “How…?” hỏi cách giữ dáng → trả lời bằng thói quen tập luyện.

questions.q:
Choose the most suitable response to complete the exchange.

Grandma: “In my day, teenagers didn't spend all day on their phones.”
Lan: “______”
o: I see your point, Grandma, but phones also help us study.
questions.e: Đáp lại một ý kiến bằng cách thừa nhận rồi nêu quan điểm khác một cách lịch sự.

questions.q:
Choose the correct order of the sentences to make a meaningful conversation.

a. Tom: Really? What do you usually argue about?
b. Lisa: I often argue with my parents these days.
c. Lisa: Mostly about my curfew and the clothes I wear.
d. Tom: Maybe you should talk to them calmly and listen to their views.
e. Lisa: That's a good idea. I'll try it tonight.
questions.e: Lisa nêu vấn đề (b) → Tom hỏi lí do (a) → Lisa trả lời (c) → Tom khuyên (d) → Lisa đồng ý (e).

questions.q:
Choose the correct order of the sentences to make a meaningful paragraph.

a. First, sensors will be used to monitor traffic and reduce congestion.
b. Cities of the future are expected to be smarter and greener.
c. Finally, residents will enjoy more green spaces and cleaner air.
d. Second, solar panels on buildings will provide renewable energy.
e. All these changes will make urban life more sustainable.
questions.e: Câu chủ đề (b) → các ý theo thứ tự First (a), Second (d), Finally (c) → câu kết (e).

questions.q:
Read the passage and choose the best option for each numbered blank.

Living a long and healthy life is something everybody wishes for. Scientists say that our daily habits play an important (1)______ in how long we live. First, a balanced diet (2)______ plenty of fruit, vegetables and whole grains provides the nutrients our body needs. Second, people (3)______ exercise regularly tend to have stronger muscles and a healthier heart. Even a 30-minute walk every day can make a big difference. Third, getting enough sleep is essential (4)______ it helps the body recover and keeps the mind sharp. (5)______, many teenagers today stay up late playing games or chatting online. Doctors advise them to cut (6)______ on screen time before bed. By making small changes now, we can enjoy a longer and happier life.

Choose the best option for blank (1).
questions.e: “play an important role in” = đóng vai trò quan trọng trong.

questions.q:
Read the passage and choose the best answer to the question.

In many Vietnamese families, three generations still live under the same roof. While this extended family structure has many advantages, it can also lead to conflicts caused by the generation gap.

One common source of disagreement is technology. Teenagers today are digital natives; they grew up with smartphones and the Internet. They use social media to make friends, study and relax. Their grandparents, however, often see these devices as a waste of time and believe young people should spend more time talking face to face.

Another issue is career choice. Many parents want their children to become doctors, engineers or teachers because these jobs are stable and respected. Young people, on the other hand, are often interested in new careers such as content creation or game design, which their parents may not fully understand.

Despite these differences, the generation gap can be bridged. Experts suggest that family members should spend quality time together, for example by having meals or doing housework together. More importantly, both sides have to listen to each other with an open mind. When teenagers explain their choices respectfully and older people share their life experience instead of giving orders, conflicts can turn into chances to understand and support one another.

What is the passage mainly about?
o: The advantages of living in an extended family.
The best careers for young people today.
The dangers of using social media.
The causes of the generation gap in families and ways to bridge it.
questions.e: Bài nêu nguyên nhân xung đột thế hệ (công nghệ, nghề nghiệp) và cách thu hẹp khoảng cách.

questions.q:
Identify the underlined part (shown in square brackets) that needs correction.

My father [has stopped] smoking two [years ago], so he [feels] [much healthier] now.
questions.e: Có “two years ago” → dùng quá khứ đơn: has stopped → stopped.

questions.q:
Identify the underlined part (shown in square brackets) that needs correction.

This apartment [is belonging] to my uncle, [who] [has lived] in the city [since] 2015.
questions.e: “belong” là động từ trạng thái, không dùng tiếp diễn: is belonging → belongs.

questions.q:
Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the given sentence.

It isn't necessary for you to bring food to the party.
o: You mustn't bring food to the party.
You should bring food to the party.
You don't have to bring food to the party.
You must bring food to the party.
questions.e: “It isn't necessary” = không cần thiết → don't have to (khác mustn't = bị cấm).

questions.q:
Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the given sentence.

I started learning English five years ago.
o: I haven't learned English for five years.
I learned English for five years and then stopped.
I have learned English for five years.
I have learned English since five years.
questions.e: started … ago ↔ have + V3 + for + khoảng thời gian; “since” phải đi với mốc thời gian.
